<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's like they said...
there's rubble piled on top of the manhole.
<CLT=cltMIND>I don't think I can get in...

<CLT=cltMIND>The only person strong enough to
move all this would be Gonta.
